description: The same command on a start that fails to capture lock and falls into mistimed but periodic commutation. One start in five.
notes: Collapses to 17.29 rad/s electrical with 41.3 % jitter and 0.798 A — about 4x the current of a locked run, with duty pinned at the ceiling.
The 50.3 rad/s handoff is only 1.26x the measured 40 rad/s back-EMF sensing floor.
Kept deliberately: a single capture of this drive proves nothing about the drive.
title: Six-step handoff: lock missed
